pages.text: A rate equation dy/dt = −ky is stepped forward by h at a time. A method of order m is off by about (hk)^(m+1)/(m+1) a step. Euler's method (order 1) and the midpoint method blow up once hk passes 2; the fourth-order Runge-Kutta method holds to 2.785. Bigger steps get there faster; a higher order is more accurate but takes more work a step.
